entries.heading: The authorities and
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 21001.  The authorities and 
limitations of section 402 of the Coronavirus Preparedness and Response 
Supplemental Appropriations Act (division A of Public Law 116-123) shall 
apply to funds appropriated by this title as follows:
            (1) Subsections (a), (d), (e), and (f) shall apply to funds 
        under the heading ``Diplomatic Programs''; and
            (2) Subsections (c), (d), (e), and (f) shall apply to funds 
        under the heading ``International Disaster Assistance''.
